"""What a training checkpoint holds: sizes of its parts, pickled and in memory."""
import pickle
import sys

import numpy as np
import torch


def deep_size(value, seen):
    if id(value) in seen:
        return 0
    seen.add(id(value))
    size = sys.getsizeof(value)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        size += sum(deep_size(k, seen) + deep_size(v, seen) for k, v in value.items())
    elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set, frozenset)):
        size += sum(deep_size(v, seen) for v in value)
    elif isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
        size += value.nbytes if value.base is None else 0
    elif isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
        size += value.numel() * value.element_size()
    return size


path = sys.argv[1]
state = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
learner = state.get("learner", state)
print("top keys:", sorted(state.keys())[:20])
holder = learner if isinstance(learner, dict) and "action_history" in learner else next(
    (v for v in state.values() if isinstance(v, dict) and "action_history" in v), None)
if holder is None:
    raise SystemExit("no action_history found")
print("learner keys:", sorted(holder.keys()))
for name in ("action_history", "replay"):
    part = holder[name]
    pickled = len(pickle.dumps(part, protocol=pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL))
    memory = deep_size(part, set())
    print(f"{name}: {len(part)} items, pickled {pickled / 1e6:.1f} MB ({pickled / max(len(part), 1):.0f} B each), "
          f"in memory about {memory / 1e6:.1f} MB ({memory / max(len(part), 1):.0f} B each)")
print("counters:", holder.get("counters"))
import json, os
result = {"checkpoint": path, "checkpoint_bytes": os.path.getsize(path), "counters": holder.get("counters")}
for name in ("action_history", "replay"):
    part = holder[name]
    result[name] = {"items": len(part), "pickled_bytes": len(pickle.dumps(part, protocol=pickle.HIGHEST_PROTOCOL)),
                    "python_object_bytes": deep_size(part, set())}
print("JSON " + json.dumps(result))
